ceu: ✦ The square between Mars and Jupiter

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between relationships and family. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between routine and conversations. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between romance and money. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between family and your image. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between money and friendships. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between your image and your career. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
From {H:1826401169000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Mars and Jupiter creates some tension between your career and relationships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.
